info.name: TiDB Cloud Data Service OPEN OpenAPI Specification API
Get the OpenAPI Specification of a Data App.

params.name: dataAppId
params.description: The ID of the Data App. You can get the ID from the response of [List all Data Apps in a project](#tag/Data-App/operation/DataApp_ListDataApps).

params.name: format
params.description: The format of the generated OpenAPI Specification.

items.docs: TiDB Cloud Data Service supports generating the OpenAPI Specification 3.0 for each Data App, which enables you to interact with your endpoints in a standardized format. You can use this specification to generate standardized OpenAPI documentation, client SDKs, and server stubs.
